conductor.name: conductor
conductor.title: Conductor
conductor.summary: Master orchestrator: authentication, the service registry + proxy, worker fleet management, project scoping, and the React Native dashboard. Every client and SDK call enters here.

endpoints.summary: Enable/deploy a service for a project
Generic proxy to a manager (JWT/service token)
Update host OS or Docker ({ target })
Enable wanted[] then provision resources (never prod UUID)
Roll back last applied stack revision
Hook up edge using existing Cloudflare secrets

managers.name: key_manager
managers.summary: Key management service: symmetric/data keys, envelope encryption, rotation. Backs storage + secrets encryption.

endpoints.summary: Create a key ({ name, type, algorithm })

managers.name: storage_manager
managers.summary: Object storage: buckets + objects with envelope encryption, multipart/chunked uploads, and signed URLs.

env.name: MOCK_KEY_MANAGER
env.desc: Use a local dev key instead of key_manager

managers.name: db_manager
managers.summary: Managed database control plane: provision/start/stop/restart database containers, backups + restore, health and volumes.

managers.name: compute_manager
managers.summary: Run containerized tasks (dockerode): create/list/get/stop/delete project-scoped tasks with port maps and labels.

managers.name: queue_manager
managers.summary: Message queues with four real engines: standard/fifo (SQLite), rabbitmq (AMQP), redis_stream (XADD/XREADGROUP). List returns engine, dlq, depth.

managers.name: schedule_manager
managers.summary: Cron schedules that dispatch to a webhook or a queue. Run-now supported.

managers.name: network_manager
managers.summary: Per-project Docker bridge networks with stable names. Attach service containers for isolation.

managers.name: logs_manager
managers.summary: Append-only log events with levels and context. Batch ingest for the worker outbox/shipper.

managers.name: metrics_manager
managers.summary: Stored metric samples (name/value/labels). Aggregation cluster is future work.

managers.name: security_manager
managers.summary: Security finding records (severity/source/details). Detectors wired later.

managers.name: analytics_manager
managers.summary: Product analytics events (event/value/properties).

managers.name: iam_manager
managers.summary: Roles, policies (allow/deny JSON documents), and role↔policy bindings. Enforcement lives in the conductor.

endpoints.summary: Attach a policy to a role

managers.name: secrets_manager
managers.summary: Encrypted secrets (AES-256-GCM envelope via key_manager). List never returns plaintext; ?reveal=1 for value.

env.name: MOCK_KEY_MANAGER
env.desc: Local dev key instead of key_manager

managers.name: auth_manager
managers.summary: OIDC provider metadata (issuer/client_id/config). Keep client_secret in secrets_manager.
managers.needsKeys: OIDC client_secret (store in secrets_manager) to complete real auth flows.

managers.name: tunnel_manager
managers.summary: Create/delete Cloudflare tunnels (cloudflared) from the edge to private origins. Token returned once on create.

managers.name: domain_manager
managers.summary: Cloudflare DNS records (CRUD per zone + project). Pairs with tunnel_manager for public hostnames.

managers.name: cdn_manager
managers.summary: CDN-style cache rules (path pattern, origin, TTL). Config only in MVP.

managers.name: balancer_manager
managers.summary: Load-balancer target hints (addresses). No cloud LB provisioning in MVP.

managers.name: webhook_manager
managers.summary: Outbound webhooks: endpoints with secret + headers, and a dispatch action. SKIP_OUTBOUND=1 to avoid network.

endpoints.summary: Send a payload to the endpoint

managers.name: email_manager
managers.summary: Email messages (to/subject/body). Send when SMTP secrets exist; otherwise queue-only.
managers.needsKeys: Queued only this pass. Do not retry live SMTP send.

managers.name: sms_manager
managers.summary: SMS messages (to_number/body). Send when Twilio secrets exist; otherwise queue-only.
managers.needsKeys: Queued only this pass. Do not retry live Twilio send.

managers.name: slack_manager
managers.summary: Slack posts (channel/text). Send when Slack secrets exist; otherwise queue-only.
managers.needsKeys: Queued only this pass. Do not retry live Slack post.

managers.name: git_manager
managers.summary: Self-hosted Git hosting: bare repos + full clone/push/pull over Git Smart HTTP, plus push-event hooks.

endpoints.summary: Git Smart HTTP transport (clone/push/pull, direct port)

env.name: GIT_AUTH_TOKEN
env.desc: Optional Bearer/Basic token for the transport

managers.name: registry_manager
managers.summary: Container registry discovery: per-project registry entries (no pull secrets) + a public config endpoint.

managers.name: cicd_manager
managers.summary: Pipeline definitions (steps JSON + state). Real runners are future work.

managers.name: code_as_infra
managers.summary: Infrastructure-as-code modules / snippets (kind + content).

managers.name: api_manager
managers.summary: Gateway route definitions (method/public_path/backend_url).

managers.name: app_manager
managers.summary: App project metadata (repo_url/build_command).

managers.name: mcp_manager
managers.summary: MCP tool registry (description + input_schema). GET /platform-tools lists schemas for backup/iac/edge/systems/graphql/search.

endpoints.summary: Catalog input_schema for platform tools (backup, iac, edge, systems, graphql, search, stack)
Invoke a registered tool against input_schema.endpoint

managers.name: ai_manager
managers.summary: Place GPU engines; intelligence jobs; Icarus shop (user layer / manager / workers) and dynamic connectors. Poll + WS ai:live, ai:agent.ask, ai:agent.pulse, ai:agent.done.
managers.needsKeys: LLM endpoint/URL + provider keys (e.g. Ollama URL) to run inference.

endpoints.summary: Placeable engine kinds (vLLM, STT, Kokoro, XTTS, Ollama, cache)
Place { kind, worker_id } on a GPU worker (no auto-start for vLLM/XTTS/Ollama)
Cancel a queued or running job
Icarus fabric probe (Orin AI, prod-mini computer)
Idempotent agent setup (intelligence, memory, RAG, settings)
Project agent settings (concurrency, jail, write policy)
Boot resume: heal, due crons (late labeled), learn jobs, workers, idle last
Create a named Icarus agent (ARN ai:agent:endpoint/name)
Get agent by id or name
Update agent knobs (mode, binds, timezone, notify)
Wipe friend memory for this agent
JPEG screenshot for a browse ASK
Open and answered ASK cards (one open at a time)
Shop timeline (chat, brief, ask, tool, replan, deploy)
Fire a cron via runtime (user_turn / idle_review / shop plan)
Run a workspace command (ASK if mutating)
Execute a workspace tool (ASK on writes)
Invoke a connector tool (ASK if needs_auth)

managers.name: crawler_manager
managers.summary: Crawl job metadata (start_url/max_depth/state). Real fetching needs network egress.
managers.needsKeys: Network egress + enabling real fetch to crawl.

managers.name: host_manager
managers.summary: Host inventory synced from conductor /api/workers (not a second fleet to register by hand).

managers.name: worker_manager
managers.summary: Worker/fleet labels synced from conductor /api/workers.

managers.name: system_manager
managers.summary: Fleet patch board plus host OS/Docker check and update. Always on per device; no project enable.

endpoints.summary: Update host OS or Docker ({ target })

managers.name: websocket_manager
managers.summary: WebSocket channels.

managers.name: event_manager
managers.summary: Event buses.

managers.name: download_manager
managers.summary: Download lists.

managers.name: backup_manager
managers.summary: Backup vaults and snapshot jobs into the aerekos-backups bucket. Restore db/storage/git/generic JSON.

endpoints.summary: Run a backup job { project_id, source, resource, vault }

managers.name: workflow_manager
managers.summary: Run state machines (http, queue, wait, choice, function). Email/SMS/Slack steps are skipped.

managers.name: config_manager
managers.summary: Config namespaces plus /evaluate against stored flags.

managers.name: cert_manager
managers.summary: Import PEM or mint self-signed certificates. No Let's Encrypt.

managers.name: billing_manager
managers.summary: Usage meters. /evaluate-quota uses real counts and denies when over; never { unlimited: true }.

managers.name: function_manager
managers.summary: Lambda analog. Deploy/invoke plus EventSource attach/detach. Always-on poller drains inbox queues; invoke failures nack toward DLQ.

endpoints.summary: Attach a queue (provision inbox+DLQ if missing)
Detach a queue (does not delete it)

managers.name: iot_manager
managers.summary: IoT things.

managers.name: graphql_manager
managers.summary: GraphQL APIs compiled from Data API models. POST /execute runs queries against those models.

endpoints.summary: Compile schema from Data API models
Execute a GraphQL query/mutation against Data API

managers.name: notebook_manager
managers.summary: Store notebooks; Run launches a compute oneshot (jupyter/python).

managers.name: trace_manager
managers.summary: OTLP/HTTP ingest plus span list/query in SQLite.

managers.name: search_manager
managers.summary: SQLite FTS search. POST /query returns real hits (empty only when the index is empty).

managers.name: query_manager
managers.summary: SQL queries.

managers.name: waf_manager
managers.summary: WAF rules.

managers.name: vpn_manager
managers.summary: Headscale preauth keys when HEADSCALE_URL is set; otherwise not-hooked-up.

endpoints.summary: Create a Headscale preauth key (or not-hooked-up)

managers.name: transfer_manager
managers.summary: SFTP endpoints that put/get objects through storage_manager.

managers.name: audit_manager
managers.summary: Audit events.

managers.name: status_manager
managers.summary: Status incidents.

managers.name: cluster_manager
managers.summary: Docker fleet inventory on the worker host. Optional k3s detect/install only on explicit confirm — never auto-install on prod.

endpoints.summary: List docker containers on this host
Install k3s only if { confirm: true }

managers.name: vector_manager
managers.summary: Upsert/query via db_manager vectors or sqlite cosine (facade, not a second RAG).

managers.name: push_manager
managers.summary: Push subscriptions. Send when FCM secret exists; otherwise queue-only.
managers.needsKeys: Queued only this pass. Do not retry live FCM send.
